name: com.every-ai/ai-tools
title: EveryAI
description: Pick the right AI tool for any task: search 2,000+ reviewed AI tools, or list yours on EveryAI.

tools.name: recommend_tool
tools.description: Pick the best AI tools for a job the user wants done. Call this whenever a user asks which AI tool, app or service to use ("what should I use to transcribe my podcast?", "is there an AI that makes pitch decks?", "best free logo maker"), or when you need a tool to finish their task and do not already know a current one. Pass the job in plain words, plus any budget, platform, must-have features and tools to leave out. Returns up to 3 picks from EveryAI's 2,700+ reviewed listings, each with why it fits (quoted from its listing), pricing as stated, a link to give the user, a 0-100 data-quality score and a last-verified date, plus the alternatives considered and why they ranked lower. Ranking is by fit and data quality only: payment never changes rank, and a paid placement can only appear separately as "sponsored" with sponsored:true. Fewer than 3 picks (or none) means nothing else fits: say so instead of guessing. Do not use it to look up one named tool (get_tool) or to browse a category (search_tools).

task.description: What the user wants to get done, in plain words, e.g. "transcribe podcast episodes with speaker labels" or "write cold outreach emails for B2B sales". Describe the job, not a product name; leave out names, emails and other personal details.

budget.description: "free", or the most the user will pay per month in USD (20, "$20/month"). Tools whose listing states a higher price, or no free option when "free", are left out. Tools with a confirmed price are picked first; one that states no price is only offered when fewer than three confirmed tools fit, marked unconfirmed. pricing.stated_by says whether a price is from the maker, auto-detected, or read from listing text.

platform.description: Where it has to run or what it has to plug into: ios, android, mobile, chrome, mac, windows, linux, desktop, web, api, mcp, cli, vscode, slack, discord, telegram, whatsapp, wordpress, shopify, figma, notion, self_hosted, or any other product name. Only tools whose listing mentions it are picked ("web" is not enforced: most listed tools are web apps).

must_have.description: Features the tool must mention on its listing, a few words each, e.g. ["speaker labels", "SRT export"]. A tool missing any of them is not picked.

exclude.description: Tools to leave out (ones the user already tried or ruled out), by name, slug or website.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Put two listed AI tools side by side: category, use case, stated pricing, platforms, features, data quality and last-verified dates, with the fields where they differ called out. Call this when the user is choosing between two specific tools ("X or Y?", "how does X compare to Y?"), often after recommend_tool. Pass "task" to also see which listing covers that job better. Every value is what the listing states; a missing value means not stated, not absent from the product.

a.description: The first tool. A tool's slug ("acme-notes-jd7abc12"), EveryAI page URL, website ("https://acme.ai") or exact name ("Acme Notes").

b.description: The second tool, given the same way.

task.description: Optional: the job the user wants done, to see which of the two fits it better.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Everything EveryAI lists about one AI tool: description, features, category and use case, pricing as its listing states it, platforms it mentions, a 0-100 data-quality score (completeness, link health, freshness), last-verified date and links. Call this when the user names a specific tool and wants its details, or before repeating a claim about a tool from recommend_tool or search_tools. If the name is not an exact match you get suggestions instead.

tool.description: A tool's slug ("acme-notes-jd7abc12"), EveryAI page URL, website ("https://acme.ai") or exact name ("Acme Notes").

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Keyword search of the EveryAI directory, up to 50 results: use it to browse a category, list what exists for a topic, or find a tool by name. To choose a tool for a user's task, call recommend_tool instead (it applies constraints, explains each pick and ranks without regard to payment). Results carry the EveryAI page, website, category and a short description; ties go to listings marked "featured", which are paid placements.

q.description: A topic or a tool name. Leave empty to list the newest tools (featured first).

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: Whether a website already has a live EveryAI listing, and what its owner can do next (claim it, or list it if it is not there yet).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: EveryAI's categories with their use cases (subcategories), hub pages and how many tools each has.

tools.name: get_featured_offer
tools.description: What a Featured listing on EveryAI costs (one-time, no subscription), what it includes, and how a founder buys it. Pass the founder's country for their price.

country.description: The founder's billing country as an ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. "US", "IN", "DE".

tools.name: prepare_submission
tools.description: For a founder who wants their tool on EveryAI: returns a link to the submit form prefilled with the details you pass. Nothing is submitted; the founder opens it, signs in, and submits free or pays for Featured themselves. If the site is already listed, returns that listing and how to claim it instead.

description.description: One or two sentences on what it does and for whom.

subcategory.description: A use case inside the category (see list_categories).

plan.description: Which plan the form opens on; the founder can switch.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: List a founder's AI tool on EveryAI now. Pass the details and the founder's email: the listing is created for them, EveryAI emails them a link to confirm it (no account or sign-in needed), and you get back a $19 one-time Featured checkout URL. List it as Featured on EveryAI for $19 once: it skips the free launch queue (submit_tool answers with the date a free listing would launch) and launches today, gets a permanent do-follow backlink, is pinned above free listings, and competes for the #1-#3 AI Launch of the Day badges. Give the URL to the founder, or pay it yourself if they authorised you to. Free listings join the launch queue once confirmed.

description.description: One or two sentences on what it does and for whom.

founderEmail.description: The founder's own email, with their consent. EveryAI sends the confirm link here and the listing belongs to this address.

subcategory.description: A use case inside the category (see list_categories).

plan.description: "featured" also returns a $19 checkout URL; "free" only queues it after the founder confirms.

agent.description: Who is submitting, e.g. "Claude for Jane Doe" (shown to the founder and reviewers).
